name: repeatedly blend adjacent control points at the parameter until one remains
mechanism: replace each adjacent pair of control points by their weighted average at the parameter value (weights from the knot positions), then repeat on the shorter list until a single point remains; that point is the curve value, and only convex combinations are ever formed

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'De Boor algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Interpolation and extrapolation: B-splines
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'De Casteljau's algorithm': Bézier curves

requires: control points and (for the general form) a knot vector
fails_when: quadratic in the degree per evaluation
